Intentio igitur Sergij hęc fuit, Debes mihi vitium, quod in vendendo non dixisti, praestare. D. nō debeo. Q. an debeat. R. Quia vi

page.notes: The running head is largely worn. Only "IVRIS" and fragments of the rest are legible; the title word is illegible. Several marks in the text ("«", "ɔ") are printed quotation or speaker marks and were copied as shown. Line-end hyphens in "e-des", "decep-tū" and "igitur" are doubtful; "igitur" was joined as no printed hyphen was clearly visible. The reading "ęquitate" and "sciēs" is uncertain. The final word is cut off at the line end and continues in the catchword "tium".
